notes: Prescribed directly to client portal following metabolic plateau trigger.
content:
CLINICAL PROTOCOL: 7-DAY LEPTIN & CARB RE-FEED MICRO-CYCLE

Client: Elena Rostova
Prescribing Coach: Coach Vance
Indications: 12-day weight plateau, resting body temp dip (-0.4°C), nocturnal cortisol spike.

Prescription Directives:
- Daily Carbohydrates: Increase baseline from 185g to 210g (+25g complex carbs with breakfast).
- Re-feed Days (Tuesday & Saturday): 280g Carbohydrates, 130g Protein, 40g Fat (Total 2,000 kcal).
- Fluid & Electrolytes: 3.5L water with 1,000mg sodium / 400mg potassium buffer during high-cadence training.
- Telemetry Requirement: Log resting HR and waking blood glucose within 30 min of waking.
